requirements.title: High-velocity collision protection envelope
requirements.description: At ~0.016 c (~4.8e6 m/s) even small grains cause severe local damage. Critical non-sacrificial hardware must stay inside a validated collision-protection envelope, or it needs an independently justified protective system.
requirements.principle: The envelope comes from the shield's real silhouette, its station and the modelled arrival directions, not from a universal diameter limit. Geometric coverage is necessary, not sufficient.
current: forward shield r 45 m (canon WORKING 90 m) at x 260.5 m after the T-B bow shift
FDP-1 engine hardware reaches r 112.5 m (nozzle loop 3, its feeds and armour)
requirements.target: every critical part inside the shield shadow for the design arrival cone and margin, plus validated stopping, ejecta and penetration performance
requirements.gap: nozzle loops 2 and 3, Fiji lattice, loop armour, sector feeds and strut hardware lie outside the 45 m shadow even for an aligned stream; the 3.6 km wings are edge-on and ~96 % outside it
